notes.title: Update Notes for February 22, 2025
notes.notes:
1. An auto-attack feature will be added.
  You can enable auto-attack during the game by pressing the Tab key.
  Auto-attack will automatically target and attack the nearest enemy around the hero.

2. While using auto-attack, you can choose the auto-attack type.
  Move Priority: Does not attack nearby enemies while moving.
  Attack Priority: Prioritizes attacking nearby enemies if they are present.
  You can switch between these two modes by pressing the Ctrl key.

notes.title: Update Note For February 13 2025
notes.notes:
Hello, players!  
We are excited to share the update details for February 13th.

  
1. **5th Hero: Jupien of Machinery** is now available!  
   Jupien is a hero who specializes in controlling machines, commanding drones and robots that automatically attack enemies.  
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322372/bc69f7f26c752e22667a26d720424caa1594c198.png

  -Basic Attack: 2 Drones
  Jupien is accompanied by two autonomous attack drones.  
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322372/4083feef5f905e5c013f27ca1056e50ffed63fc9.gif

  -Attack Skill: Disruptive Wave Generator
  Deploys a wave generator that disrupts enemies. The wave reduces enemy defense.  
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322372/5e1a536f7e424e9f9496c70bb54c7f19c7c3346c.gif

  -Special Attack Skill: Laser Blaster
  Fires multiple powerful lasers to annihilate enemies.  
  {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322372/f96a79a5729f705b3d3e85c19d622b25ab4c50a6.gif

  -Movement Skill: Tactical Maneuver
  Instantly moves to a new position while increasing attack power and penetration.

notes.title: Update Note For February 6, 2025

1. Marté(Hero)'s new skill : Flame Dash
 A movement skill that allows the hero to dash forward quickly while attacking monsters.

2. Marté(Hero)'s new skill : Flame Spirit

 The campfire increases the damage of nearby heroes' fire-attribute attacks.
